reason: An update-monitoring plugin that shows the DeepSeek Harness version in the Web GUI, checks public npm registries for newer releases, and presents update status and diagnostics.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 顶栏显示版本信息，检查公开 npm registry 的新版本并提供更新状态与诊断面板。
summaries.en: Shows the DeepSeek Harness version in the Web GUI top bar, checks public npm registries for newer releases, and provides update status and diagnostics.

capabilities: Displays the installed DeepSeek Harness version in the session top bar
Checks public npm registries for the latest DeepSeek Harness version
Reads local @deepseek-ai/dsh package metadata to detect the installed version
Provides an API route and comparison panel for update status and diagnostics
